query: Which unit of analysis (individual student, small group, episode) best captures participation frequency in mixed-gender and streamed classrooms?

response.query: Which unit of analysis (individual student, small group, episode) best captures participation frequency in mixed-gender and streamed classrooms?
response.answer: The individual student unit best captures participation frequency in mixed-gender and streamed classrooms. Small group analysis may miss individual participation nuances. Episode analysis could aggregate data but lacks individual detail.
